props.name: nodes
props.description: Nodes, in the order they should be preferred when the layout has a free choice.

props.name: source
props.description: The graph as text, used instead of `nodes` and `edges`. One chain per line: `a -> b -> c`, with `id[Label]` to name a node and `: text` after the last node to label the final edge. `#` starts a comment.

props.name: direction
props.description: Top to bottom or left to right.

props.name: onNodeSelect
props.description: Called with a node id when Enter is pressed on it or it is clicked.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the viewport in pixels. The diagram is fitted inside it.
